weather_report:
As the night drapes itself over Downtown San Francisco, the air carries a gentle hint of warmth, settling around a comfortable 57 degrees. The streets, occasionally tinged with the soft glow of streetlights, breathe a sigh of relief beneath a partly cloudy sky, as a light southwest wind dances through the night. Tomorrow, the sun will reign supreme, promising a splendid day ahead. With a high near 71, temperatures will dip slightly in the afternoon, but don’t expect the fog to intrude; today’s sunshine is likely to cast a bright glow over the cityscape, enhancing the distinct contours of the skyline and the majestic silhouette of the Golden Gate Bridge.

The visibility seems promising this morning, with the haze surprisingly clear for the most part. Although the marine layer remains distant, tempted to shield its cool breath over the shores, it appears to have held back for the day. Delicate shorts and a breezy shirt will serve you well, though a light jacket may offer comfort as evening approaches. Such a delightful day nudges you toward the simple pleasures of life; a stroll along the Embarcadero with a freshly brewed cup of coffee could serve as a perfect excuse to relish the moment. Alternatively, a quiet afternoon in a sun-drenched park could offer the solitude we sometimes crave. Whatever your choice, the conditions beckon with a warmth that promises many gentle memories.
